name: codex-jev
description: Jev-gated filtering for repetitive output, test/build logs, and broad search/listing results.

interface.shortDescription: Filter large tool results before they enter context.
interface.longDescription: Codex Jev offers three selectable PostToolUse filters for repetitive output, routine test/build logs, and broad search or file listings. Eligible results get one bounded Jev judgment; replacement preserves a recoverable exact original. A companion VS Code control shows connection health and recent outcomes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain Codex Jev's replacement decisions and safety gates.
